text: Program Description I. University Introduction Ningxia Medical University (NXMU) was founded in 1958. It is a higher medical university with a certain influence and popularity among similar colleges in China, which was authorized to enroll international students by Ministry of Education (MOE LIST), and also authorized by China Scholarship Council to cultivate the Chinese government scholarship students. Until now, over 400 international students from 51 countries study here. II. Program Overview The program is oriented by job competence in line with the basic requirements of training objectives in international clinical medicine, and medical needs of the countries of origin, as well as international requirements of source countries or serving in a third country after graduation. Aiming to cultivate specialized talents with solid basic medical knowledge, standardized clinical skills, good professional quality, preliminary ability of international exchange and cooperation, recognition and adaptation to cultural diversity, and the ability to use Chinese language to provide medical, teaching and scientific research work in the medical and health service sector. III. Program Duration 5 years ( The 1st-4th year are theoretical studies, the 5th year is internship)
